messages:
sasha: Kicking off v2 canary within change window — 5% traffic for 20m. Watching errors, p95, and rerank quality. Handing operator watch to @mike. :rocket:
sasha: Rollback triggers: error delta, p95 spike, or rerank regressions. Will pause expansion if any trip.
deploy-bot: [automation] Starting canary id=cb-2177777777 route=api.v2 weight=5% duration=20m
mike: on it — I'll monitor dashboards and alert channel.
maya: release notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2 — includes dual-header gating section.
kevin: Quick Q — header gate strategy? legacy clients still send `X-Redwood-Client: v1`
sasha: plan = dual-accept for 1 week. New clients opt-in via header. We'll pin mobile shard to v1 temporarily.
kevin: need the pin command — can ops run it?
sasha: run this to pin mobile shard:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/pins \
  -d '{"client":"mobile-iOS","pin":"v1-temp","until":"2026-03-27T12:00:00Z"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```
kevin: applying now.
ops-bot: pin applied: mobile-iOS -> v1-temp by kevin (expires 2026-03-27T12:00:00Z)
ops-bot: safety-meter: baseline p50=48ms p95=220ms err_rate=0.4%
deploy-bot: canary progress: 1m elapsed, weight=5%, requests=12k, v2 p95=240ms (+20ms), errors=0.6% (+0.2%)
mike: seeing a small p95 blip, watching graphs. :eyes:
maya: note — update SDK changelog and support article before public announce.
sasha: trigger recap for thread: - error rate delta >= 2% absolute - p95 +50ms sustained 3m - rerank false-positive > 1%
mike: set chart alert for those thresholds and will DM ops if anything trips.
kevin: will hold mobile canary at 0% expansion until backend confirms rerank fix.
ops-bot: alert: rerank-test false-positive = 1.3% (3m window) :rotating_light:
sasha: pausing traffic expansion. initiating mitigation to avoid full rollback.
mike: proposed quick mitigation — route rerank traffic with header check fallback to v1:
```
if header 'x-rerank-mode' == 'new' then route v2 else route v1
```
kevin: applying router patch now to enable that fallback.
deploy-bot: router patch applied: rerank header fallback enabled (no global rollback)
ops-bot: draft post-release note created at doc/internal/release/2177777777-canary-note.md
maya: set status page to "partial canary paused". hold external comms until we confirm stability.
sasha: thanks everyone. keeping thread as source-of-truth. handoff to @mike to watch next 40m. :eyes:
